bio: A warm and intimate atmosphere reigns in this cosy place, where diners are treated to cordial service with a personal touch. French classics dominate the menu, but there are also Italian-influenced specialities, as well as lobster dishes. Think perfectly pan-seared langoustines with a lobster bisque mayonnaise, accompanied by an aubergine croquette and a curry sauce. Or how about a rich and creamy blanquette de veau? Should you wish to swap out a standard set menu item for one of the daily specials, the team will be happy to oblige. Expect genuine hospitality and fantastic value for money!...
